## GenomicSEM Loneliness and Immune Conditions
- Specifies main adjusted multivariate regression models between loneliness and immune conditions, psych conditions and immune biomarkers (+covariates)
- Can either specify manually (like I did here) or can use genomicsem_1_interactive.R to specify each individual model
- genomicsem_2_mediation.R allows specification of multiple possible mediation models 
- this project only focuses on triglycerides, neutrophils, crp and il-6 based on results of adjusted modelling
- next interesting candidate to look at is neuroticism, which is associated with loneliness and may be linked to immune function too

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

#### Import Data and Load GenomicSEM
```{r read output from cluster, echo=FALSE}
library(GenomicSEM)

```

#### Sanity Check Matrix
```{r sanity, echo=FALSE}
covstruc <- readRDS("/vast/palmer/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/genomic_sem/LDSCoutput.rds")

covstruc$N
dim(covstruc$S)
dim(covstruc$V)


S <- covstruc$S
V <- covstruc$V

# Assign missing row names
if (is.null(rownames(S))) {
  rownames(S) <- colnames(S)
}

# Verify
stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(S), colnames(S)),
  isSymmetric(S)
)

```

#### Checking Correlations and QC of GenomicSEM LDSC

- AoU Loneliness has a strong correlation with PanUKB Loneliness isolation (rg = 0.791)
```{r AoU and PanUKB Loneliness rg, echo=FALSE}
S <- covstruc$S
rownames(S) <- colnames(S)
rg <- S["LONELY", "LONELY_AOU"] / sqrt(S["LONELY", "LONELY"] * S["LONELY_AOU", "LONELY_AOU"])
rg
```

```{r Loneliness correlations, echo=FALSE}
round(cov2cor(S)["LONELY", ], 2)
diag(cov2cor(S))[c("LONELY", "LONELY_AOU")]
```
## Modeling

#### Loneliness ~ Psychiatric Conditions
- adjusting for BMI, income
- excluding BIP because it did not remain sig rg with loneliness in LDSC heatmap

```{r adjusted psych model}

# setting these to latent factors so GenomicSEM works 
psych_adjusted <- '
  ANX_F      =~ 1*ANX
  DEP_F      =~ 1*DEP
  PTSD_F     =~ 1*PTSD
  ADHD_F     =~ 1*ADHD
  ANOREXIA_F =~ 1*ANOREXIA
  ASD_F      =~ 1*ASD
  OCD_F      =~ 1*OCD
  SCZ_F      =~ 1*SCZ
  INCOME_F   =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F      =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F   =~ 1*LONELY

  LONELY_F ~ ANX_F + DEP_F + PTSD_F + ADHD_F + ASD_F + 
             ANOREXIA_F + OCD_F + SCZ_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_psych_adjusted <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = psych_adjusted,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

fit_psych_adjusted
```
- loneliness has widespread associations with anxiety, depression, ptsd, adhd, income and bmi
```{r forest plot, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_psych_adjusted$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_psych <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic association with loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genomic SEM: Loneliness (PanUKB) and Psychiatric Disorders",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for Income, BMI and Psychiatric Comorbidity"
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) + 
  theme_classic() + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p_unstand_psych
```

- after adjusting for comorbid psychiatric conditions and income + BMI, depression, PTSD, anxiety, ADHD remain significantly associated with loneliness (genetically)

```{r STD Forest Plot, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_psych_adjusted$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

# Convert estimates to numeric in case they were imported as character.
plot_data$STD_Genotype <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$STD_Genotype))
)
plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE))
)

# Keep only rows with usable estimates and standard errors.
plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(STD_Genotype) & is.finite(STD_Genotype_SE)
)

# Approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$STD_Genotype - 1.96 * plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$STD_Genotype + 1.96 * plot_data$STD_Genotype_SE

# Order by absolute estimate; largest magnitude appears at the top.
plot_data$rhs <- as.character(plot_data$rhs)
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[order(plot_data$STD_Genotype)]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = STD_Genotype, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.18,
    color = "grey35"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("_F$", "", x)) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized genetic path to loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Conditional genetic associations with loneliness",
    subtitle = "Points are STD_Genotype estimates; bars are approximate 95% CIs"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```

#### Loneliness and Immune Biomarkers (Adjusted)

- excluding WBC, Basophil, TNF
```{r loneliness immune biomarkers}
# setting these to latent factors so GenomicSEM works 
biomarker_adjusted <- '
  LYMPH_F     =~ 1*LYMPH
  EOS_F       =~ 1*EOS
  MONO_F      =~ 1*MONO
  NEUT_F      =~ 1*NEUT
  PLT_F       =~ 1*PLT
  ALBUMIN_F   =~ 1*ALBUMIN
  CRP_F       =~ 1*CRP
  TG_F        =~ 1*TG
  IL6_F       =~ 1*IL6
  GLYCA_F     =~ 1*GLYCA
  INCOME_F    =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F       =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F    =~ 1*LONELY

  LONELY_F ~ LYMPH_F + EOS_F + MONO_F + NEUT_F + GLYCA_F
            + PLT_F + ALBUMIN_F + CRP_F + TG_F + + IL6_F + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_biomarker_adjusted <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,

)
```

#### Loneliness and Immune Conditions

#### Fully adjusted model

- excluding anything that doesn't remain in the previous models 

```{r full joint model}
full_adjusted <- '
  ANX_F      =~ 1*ANX
  DEP_F      =~ 1*DEP
  PTSD_F     =~ 1*PTSD
  ADHD_F     =~ 1*ADHD
  INCOME_F   =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F      =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F   =~ 1*LONELY
  NEUT_F      =~ 1*NEUT
  ALBUMIN_F   =~ 1*ALBUMIN
  CRP_F       =~ 1*CRP
  TG_F        =~ 1*TG
  IL6_F       =~ 1*IL6
  ASTHMA_F      =~ 1*ASTHMA
  T2D_F       =~ 1*T2D
  
  LONELY_F ~ ANX_F + DEP_F + PTSD_F + ADHD_F
            + NEUT_F + ALBUMIN_F + CRP_F + TG_F + IL6_F + ASTHMA_F + T2D_F + 
             + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_full_adjusted <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = full_adjusted,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

fit_full_adjusted


```
```{r plotting full joint, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_full_adjusted$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_joint <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic association with loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genomic SEM: Loneliness (PanUKB) and Traits",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for Income, BMI, Immune Biomarkers, and Comorbidity"
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) + 
  theme_classic() + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p_unstand_joint
```

- everything still associated with loneliness except for IL-6

## Mediation Models
```{r loading mediation function, echo=FALSE}
getwd()
source("genomicsem_2_mediation.R")
source("genomicsem_1_interactive.R")

```

```{r specify mediators and outcomes}
mediators <- c("TG", "NEUT", "CRP", "ALBUMIN", "PLT")
outcomes  <- c("DEP", "PTSD", "ANX", "ADHD", "ASTHMA", "T2D", "ALL_RHINITIS")
```

```{r looping through mediators and outcomes}
library(GenomicSEM)

med_fits <- list()
for (m in mediators) {
  for (o in outcomes) {
    med_fits[[paste(m, o, sep = "_2_")]] <- fit_med(m, o)
  }
}
```

```{r show table of mediation fits}
med_tab <- collect_mediation(med_fits)
knitr::kable(med_tab, digits = 3)
```


```{r saving mediation estimates, echo=FALSE}

setwd("/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/immune/")

write.csv(med_tab, "results/genomic_sem/mediation_paths.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r plotting indirect effects}
med_plot_df <- med_tab
med_plot_df$mediator <- factor(med_plot_df$mediator, levels = c("TG", "NEUT", "CRP", "ALBUMIN", "PLT"))
med_plot_df$outcome  <- factor(med_plot_df$outcome,
                               levels = c("DEP", "PTSD", "ANX", "ADHD", "ASTHMA", "T2D", "ALL_RHINITIS"))

p_med <- ggplot(
  med_plot_df,
  aes(x = ind_est, y = outcome)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(
      xmin = ind_est - 1.96 * ind_se,
      xmax = ind_est + 1.96 * ind_se,
      shape = ind_p_FDR_BH < 0.05
    ),
    orientation = "y",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ mediator, nrow = 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "FDR ≥ 0.05", `TRUE` = "FDR < 0.05"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Indirect effect (a x b), 95% CI",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genetic associations with Loneliness, mediated by immune biomarkers",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for income and BMI"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Liberation Sans"),
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92")
  )

p_med
```

- triglycerides have a significant indirect effect on the association between loneliness and T2D, but the magnitude is very small
- all other immune biomarkers do not significantly genetically mediate this association. 


```{r attenuation plot}
# attenuation plot
source("genomicsem_1_interactive.R")
f_DEP <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "DEP"))
f_PTSD <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "PTSD"))
f_ANX <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "ANX"))
f_ADHD <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "ADHD"))
f_ASTHMA <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "ASTHMA"))
f_T2D <- quiet(fit_one("LONELY", outcome = "T2D"))

mk_base <- function(f, outcome) {
  data.frame(trait = outcome,
             Unstand_Est = as.numeric(f$path$Unstand_Est),
             Unstand_SE = as.numeric(f$path$Unstand_SE))
}

```

```{r merging mediation results, echo=FALSE}
# merge individual estimates with mediation
base6 <- rbind(mk_base(f_DEP, "DEP"), mk_base(f_PTSD, "PTSD"),
               mk_base(f_ANX, "ANX"), mk_base(f_ADHD, "ADHD"),
               mk_base(f_ASTHMA, "ASTHMA"), mk_base(f_T2D, "T2D"))

att_df <- merge(base6[, c("trait", "Unstand_Est", "Unstand_SE")],
                med_tab[, c("mediator", "outcome", "direct_est", "direct_se")],
                by.x = "trait", by.y = "outcome")

att_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(mediator = att_df$mediator, outcome = att_df$trait,
             est = att_df$Unstand_Est, se = att_df$Unstand_SE,
             model = "No biomarker adjustment"),
  data.frame(mediator = att_df$mediator, outcome = att_df$trait,
             est = att_df$direct_est, se = att_df$direct_se,
             model = "Adjusted for biomarker"))

att_long$outcome <- factor(att_long$outcome,
                           levels = c("DEP", "PTSD", "ANX", "ADHD", "ASTHMA", "T2D"))
att_long$mediator <- factor(att_long$mediator, levels = c("TG", "NEUT", "CRP", "ALBUMIN"))
```

```{r plotting attenuation, echo=FALSE}
p_att <- ggplot(att_long, aes(x = est, y = outcome, color = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = est - 1.96 * se, xmax = est + 1.96 * se),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ mediator, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "black"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Unstandardized direct effect of loneliness, 95% CI", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Liberation Sans"),
        legend.position = "top")

p_att
```
- As we saw in the observational models, we don't see a significant attenuation effect
- So while an indirect effect of triglycerides exists on Depression and T2D, it does not contribute meaningfully to the main effect

```{r plottting immune Aou, echo=FALSE}
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p_unstand_immune_sensitivity
```

- so far all findings have replicated with AoU loneliness GWAS sumstats

```{r full joint AoU}
full_adjusted_sensitivity <- '
  ANX_F      =~ 1*ANX
  DEP_F      =~ 1*DEP
  PTSD_F     =~ 1*PTSD
  ADHD_F     =~ 1*ADHD
  INCOME_F   =~ 1*INCOME
  BMI_F      =~ 1*BMI
  LONELY_F   =~ 1*LONELY_AOU
  NEUT_F      =~ 1*NEUT
  CRP_F       =~ 1*CRP
  TG_F        =~ 1*TG
  IL6_F       =~ 1*IL6
  ASTHMA_F      =~ 1*ASTHMA
  T2D_F       =~ 1*T2D
  
  LONELY_F ~ ANX_F + DEP_F + PTSD_F + ADHD_F
            + NEUT_F + CRP_F + TG_F + IL6_F + ASTHMA_F + T2D_F + 
             + INCOME_F + BMI_F
             
'

# fit model
fit_full_adjusted_sensitivity <- GenomicSEM::usermodel(
  covstruc,
  estimation = "DWLS",
  model = full_adjusted_sensitivity,
  std.lv = TRUE
)

fit_full_adjusted_sensitivity
```

```{r plotting full AoU, echo=FALSE}
# Pull the regression paths predicting loneliness from the fitted model.
plot_data <- as.data.frame(fit_full_adjusted_sensitivity$results)
plot_data <- subset(plot_data, lhs == "LONELY_F" & op == "~")

plot_data$Unstand_Est <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_Est))
)
plot_data$Unstand_SE <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(as.character(plot_data$Unstand_SE))
)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  is.finite(Unstand_Est) & is.finite(Unstand_SE)
)

plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est - 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est + 1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# Calculate approximate 95% confidence intervals.
plot_data$lower <- plot_data$Unstand_Est -
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE
plot_data$upper <- plot_data$Unstand_Est +
  1.96 * plot_data$Unstand_SE

# order traits by rg magnitude
trait_order <- plot_data$rhs[
  order(plot_data$Unstand_Est)
]
plot_data$rhs <- factor(plot_data$rhs, levels = trait_order)

plot_data <- subset(
  plot_data,
  !as.character(rhs) %in% c("BMI_F", "INCOME_F")
)

# pvalue asterisks
# Convert GenomicSEM p-values to numeric; it may report tiny values as "< 5e-300".
plot_data$p_value_num <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", as.character(plot_data$p_value)))
)

plot_data$signif <- ifelse(
  plot_data$p_value_num < 0.001, " ***",
  ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.01, " **",
         ifelse(plot_data$p_value_num < 0.05, " *", ""))
)

# Make displayed labels, stripping a trailing "_F" and adding stars.
label_map <- setNames(
  paste0(sub("_F$", "", as.character(plot_data$rhs)), plot_data$signif),
  as.character(plot_data$rhs)
)

p_unstand_full_sensitivity <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Unstand_Est, y = rhs)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    width = 0.18,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic association with loneliness",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genomic SEM: Loneliness (AoU) and all traits with multivariate adjustment",
    subtitle = "Adjusting for Income, BMI, Comorbid Conditions and Biomarkers"
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) + 
  theme_classic() + theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p_unstand_full_sensitivity
```

```{r plot mediation AoU, echo=FALSE}
med_plot_df_aou <- med_tab_aou
med_plot_df_aou$mediator <- factor(med_plot_df_aou$mediator, levels = c("TG", "NEUT", "CRP", "IL6"))
med_plot_df_aou$outcome  <- factor(med_plot_df_aou$outcome,
                               levels = c("DEP", "PTSD", "ANX", "ADHD", "ASTHMA", "T2D"))

p_med_sensitivity <- ggplot(med_plot_df_aou, aes(x = ind_est, y = outcome,
                                 color = ind_p_FDR_BH < 0.05)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ind_est - 1.96 * ind_se,
                      xmax = ind_est + 1.96 * ind_se),
                  linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ mediator, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey40", "#0279EE"),
                     labels = c("FDR > 0.05", "FDR < 0.05"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Indirect effect (a x b), 95% CI", y = NULL,
       title = "Genetic associations with Loneliness (AoU), mediated by immune biomarkers",
       subtitle = "Adjusting for income and BMI") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Liberation Sans"),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"))

p_med_sensitivity
```

- none of the mediations were significant at FDR (though T2D shows a trend for triglycerides and interleukin 6, and ADHD for triglycerides)
- probably a power-related thing

### Dual-Mediation Model 
- Linking Depression -> T2D via loneliness and triglycerides

```{r Dual Mediation}
model_dm <- paste(
  "TG ~ a1*DEP + INCOME + BMI",
  "LONELY ~ a2*DEP + INCOME + BMI",
  "T2D ~ b1*TG + b2*LONELY + c*DEP + INCOME + BMI",
  "TG ~~ LONELY",
  "ind_TG := a1*b1",
  "ind_LONELY := a2*b2",
  "ind_total := a1*b1 + a2*b2",
  sep = "
")

um_dm <- quiet(usermodel(covstruc, estimation = "DWLS", model = model_dm))

res_dm <- um_dm$results

knitr::kable(res_dm[res_dm$op == "~", ], digits = 3)
```

```{r print indirect effect, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(res_dm[res_dm$op == ":=", c("lhs", "Unstand_Est", "Unstand_SE", "p_value")],
             digits = 3)
```

#### Specific Mediation Model
- T2D -> Triglycerides -> Loneliness
- actually this ends up being the exact same estimate as Loneliness -> Triglycerides -> T2D (mathematically)


```{r}
model_mr <- paste(
  "LONELY ~ a*T2D + c*TG + INCOME + BMI",
  "TG ~ b*T2D + INCOME + BMI",
  "ind := b*c",
  sep = "
")

mr_mediation_model <- usermodel(covstruc, estimation = "DWLS", model = model_mr)

results_mr_mediation_model <- mr_mediation_model$results

knitr::kable(results_mr_mediation_model[results_mr_mediation_model$op == "~", ], digits = 3)
```
